EX-99.1 2 prok-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 ProKidney Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Highlights • On track to deliver pivotal Phase 3 PROACT 1 surrogate endpoint (eGFR slope) topline results in Q2 2027 • Anticipate completing full enrollment for the PROACT 1 confirmatory analysis in Q1 2027 with over 500 patients, up from 470, driven by accelerated patient recruitment in mid-2026 • Presented eight abstracts at ASN Kidney Week 2026, with new data further strengthening the mechanistic and clinical evidence supporting rilparencel; subsequently hosted a KOL event recapping key ASN findings and rilparencel’s potential role in advanced CKD and type 2 diabetes • Ended the third quarter with $142 million in cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities, supporting operations into mid-2027 WINSTON-SALEM, N.C., November 12, 2026 – ProKidney Corp.

“The third quarter marked continued progress for ProKidney, with PROACT 1 advancing toward full enrollment and our pivotal eGFR slope topline readout remaining on track for the second quarter of 2027,” said Bruce Culleton, M.D., CEO of ProKidney.

Together, these advances reinforce our confidence as we approach this important Phase 3 readout and continue our mission to transform the treatment of advanced CKD.” Business Highlights Phase 3 REGEN-006 (PROACT 1) Study • On track to deliver pivotal Phase 3 PROACT 1 surrogate endpoint (eGFR slope) topline results in Q2 2027; the efficacy analysis set is expected to include approximately 320 patients • Anticipate completing full enrollment for the PROACT 1 confirmatory analysis in Q1 2027 with over 500 patients, up from 470, driven by an acceleration in patient recruitment in mid-2026; the confirmatory endpoint (composite time-to-event) topline readout is expected in 2H 2029 American Society of Nephrology (ASN) Kidney Week 2026 • Presented eight abstracts with new data further strengthening the mechanistic and clinical evidence supporting rilparencel, including seven abstracts spanning CKD translational models and drug product characterization and one pooled Phase 2 clinical analysis • Following ASN Kidney Week, hosted a virtual KOL event with nephrology leader and researcher Katherine Tuttle, M.D., to discuss key mechanism of action findings, the remaining unmet need in advanced CKD and type 2 diabetes, and rilparencel’s potential role within the evolving treatment paradigm • A replay of the virtual KOL event is available in the Events & Presentations section of the Company’s website Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Liquidity: Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities as of September 30, 2026, totaled $141.9 million, compared to $181.6 million as of June 30, 2026.
